title: [AI + Weekend Polish] With Google Gemini 3 Pro I Generated This ENTIRE 5-Level Platformer - LUMINA: Chapter I
author: Significant-Wealth38
selftext:
Wild experiment: I prompted **Google Gemini 3 Pro** with "make a dark atmospheric HTML/JS platformer with 5 levels, shooting, keys, enemies, synth audio, TTS narration" and BOOM, it spat out **95% of the working code** in one massive response. Then I spent the weekend (\~15 hours) debugging physics, balancing levels, adding juice (particles, shakes, CRT effects), and making it feel human-polished.

Result: **LUMINA: Chapter I,** a browser playable gem!

**Key features (all from the AI base + my tweaks):**

* Snappy WASD/Space/Z controls (jump/shoot)
* 5 escalating levels: spikes, patrolling shooters, key-door puzzles
* Pixel style, auto-trees, trails, explosions
* Web Audio synth drone BGM + FX + eerie TTS voiceovers
* Full menus, HP system, responsive canvas

AI nailed the structure/architecture perfectly, collision, camera, even the level parser from ASCII maps. I just tuned jump height (from -9 to -11), enemy AI patrol logic, and fade transitions. Level 5 gauntlet was pure chaos till I adjusted enemy speeds.

Too AI-soulless? Suggestions to evolve it?

Any suggestions and improvements, comments below...will help me to improve the game. Or is it too simple to worth putting more development on?

Weekend AI dev out.

replies.author: Significant-Wealth38
